checks.detail: A real checked-out Git repository and original source files are required
Create and verify a package-lock.json before npm ci; GitHub main had no lockfile
Full npm test + npm build + release gates must all PASS on the actual repository
Use actual generated dist; synthetic fixtures cannot certify this release
A real deploy-preview-N--site.netlify.app URL and successful remote smoke are required
The reviewed preview must be built from exactly the source commit being released
Use only test users and isolated non-production payment/DB environment
Missing one or more real preview Login / Student / Exam / Payment / YKCR steps
Actual Android and iOS + PWA + mobile performance verification not complete
Verified rollback, named reviewer and recent sign-off are mandatory

note: GO_ELIGIBLE_FOR_FINAL_HUMAN_APPROVAL is not permission to automatically deploy. Human approval and controlled promotion are separate. No data was written by this check.
